name: Misaki G2P
purpose: Generates IPA candidates for DSD headwords. Candidates are never published; a human authors the pronunciation record.
$comment: artifactSha256 is null because nothing has been installed yet. It is the digest of the exact artifact that produced a candidate, so it can only be recorded by whoever installs it; scripts/dsd/ipa-candidates refuses to run while it is null. Pinning the revision without the artifact digest fixes what the code says, not what was executed — both are required before a candidate is admissible.
